rafael-sales: CedarBridge wants a 7-day POC next week. Scope: Okta SSO (SP-initiated + IdP metadata), SCIM (bulk seed + delta), RBAC mapping, domain proofing for an apex + several subdomains, and delegated tenant admins with audit logs. They also ran our security questionnaire and have a few blockers: can we do CNAME verification instead of TXT, how does SCIM handle deprovisioning, SCIM rate limits for bursts, and Dedicated POC pricing. Need quick confirm for kickoff. @emma-se @troy-eng @anita-ops @kate-legal

emma-se: Quick answers: We support SAML SP-initiated and ingest IdP metadata (XML/URL). SAML NameID formats supported: transient, persistent, and email; we map email NameID to userName if present. SCIM 2.0 supported: bulk endpoint for initial seeding + PATCH-based deltas for changes. Group->role mapping supported; you can set an allowlist of groups that may provision roles. Deprovisioning: we honor active=false as immediate deprovision in-app and emit deprovision webhook events. By default we soft-delete users for 30 days (configurable on Dedicated).

troy-eng: SCIM specifics: delta uses PATCH ops and our delta webhook shows only changed attrs. Recommend bulk import with pagesize ~500-1000, then enable delta. Default hosted throttle is 60 req/s; for POCs we can request a temporary bump. We support an Idempotency header X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key on bulk calls to avoid duplicate processing on retries. Consistency window is near-real-time (typically <2s) for in-memory caches, but allow for eventual consistency during heavy writes. Example PATCH we accept:

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/6f8b7c2a
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations":[
    {"op":"replace","path":"active","value":false},
    {"op":"replace","path":"groups","value":[{"value":"c_ops","display":"Customer Ops"}]}
  ]
}
```

anita-ops: Domain proofing: primary flow is DNS TXT per domain/subdomain. We can sometimes accept CNAME-based verification for customers who cannot add TXT, but that requires ops approval and a short security review (we prefer TXT). We don't support wildcard apex claims. For delegated verification across a large number of subdomains we can accept an NS delegation of a subzone if the customer can delegate; that speeds bulk claims. Typical verification completes within minutes after propagation; plan 24h buffer. For Dedicated POC pricing: options = Hosted elevated-quotas + credits (fast) or a short Dedicated trial. Ballpark Dedicated 7-day trial: $2,600/week (sales-ops to confirm). We can raise SCIM throttle for the trial window.

kate-legal: Security packet to send: SOC2 Type II summary, pen-test executive summary, encryption-at-rest + KMS note, SAML endpoints and required attributes, SCIM scope & retention, network isolation whitepaper for Dedicated, and our standard DPA. Delegated admin audit logs are retained 90 days by default; custody/retention extensions available on Dedicated. If they return the questionnaire we'll answer and flag any legal redlines; ISA/DPA redlines are separate engagements.
